title: Make concurrency tests load resilient
body:
Replace time-based waits with condition waits bounded by deadlines in GLOBAL `test/host-lock.test.mjs` for the unflocked inherited descriptor, descendants keeping the lock, and nested run, and in Product `test/verdict/sandbox.test.ts` SIGTERM/SIGINT verdict tests, `test/flow/review-parallel.test.ts`, and `test/hosts/codex-registration.test.ts` registration and `onStarted` gates. Also give `test/task/claims.test.ts:28` and `test/task/task.test.ts:16` private temporary roots instead of `.krn/runs/claude-claim-lock/scratch` with fixed worktree names, and make `test/task/claims.test.ts:254-280` independent of host load (it requires exactly 10 `--next` winners of 20). The observed host-lock failures are listed in `.krn/runs/claude-tracker-format/flaky-observed.md`; the claim test findings in `.krn/runs/independent-review-followup/report.md` (N2).
Acceptance: each test waits for its required condition, uses no fixed sleep or elapsed-time assertion, writes only under its own temporary root, and passes under concurrent load.
